title: distephana citrifolia
intro: Distephana citrifolia, commonly known as Citrus aurantium or Bitter Orange, is a small evergreen tree in the family Rutaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in weight loss due to its ability to suppress appetite. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as limonene, citral, and naringenin, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Distephana citrifolia also have a sedative effect, helping to alleviate anxiety and promote a restful sleep.
